## 0.1.7

- Respect Remnant-owned backpack sidebars on furnaces, smokers, blast furnaces, anvils, stonecutters, smithing tables, grindstones, looms, cartography tables, brewing stands, hoppers and villager trading.
- Suppress competing native screen snapshots while a module-owned sidebar controls the observed screen, and exclude appended backpack slots from native fallback snapshots.
- Cover all 16 supported Remnant menu families with ordinary and death backpacks in the native three-JVM UI fixture.
- Preserve all existing Observer bridge, authorization, privacy and input-suppression behavior.

Minecraft 26.3 / Fabric; requires TotemCore 0.7.23. Pair with TotemRemnant 0.2.29 for the additional backpack sidebars.
